title: The weight
html: Mandibular crowding of 8 mm, excessive facial convexity, and a thin phenotype immediately indicated that Billy would benefit from comprehensive correction including extractions. Although his maxillary left canine had fully erupted, the contralateral canine lagged in a vertical yet unerupted position. Your diagnostic workup confirmed that Billy’s case was a classic extraction case involving the 4 first premolars. You ordered the extractions and began leveling the arches soon thereafter. However, 5 months passed, and the upper right canine failed to erupt.
